name: Writing-on-Stone / Áísínai’pi
description: Writing-on-Stone, or Áísínai'pi ("it is pictured"), lies along the Milk River in southern Alberta, just north of the U.S. border. Wind and water have carved its sandstone cliffs into tall hoodoos. The Blackfoot people engraved and painted these walls with figures and scenes, which they regard as messages from sacred beings, and the valley remains a place of ceremony today.
